quest.title: Pigeon, Duck, and Child
quest.description: Timmie is sulking again. This time, it's not about a pigeon being scared away...

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Argh! YOU again! You've scared all my pigeons off... again!

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: I was feeding them. What do you have to say for yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oops...

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Hmph. Well, Mommy always tells me that if someone's really sorry, they will show it with their actions, not their words.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: The bridge pigeons are my friends. I feed them all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: But these days the ducks are coming and stealing their food, and the pigeons never have enough to eat anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: I want you to find three wheats for me and feed them to the ducks. While you're doing that, I can make sure the bridge pigeons get enough to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Once both sides have had enough to eat, maybe everyone can become friends.

response.speaker: Timmie
response.text: If you treat the animals well, maybe you can become friends with them too.

choices.text: I seek not the friendship of pigeons.

response.speaker: Timmie
response.text: Whether you want to be their friend or not... You owe them an apology!

response.speaker: Timmie
response.text: So hurry up and get that wheat!

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Found the wheat yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yep.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: It looks like enough.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Take it down to the lake and feed it to the ducks.

talks.objective: Go to the lakeside and scatter the Wheat

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Have you found the wheat yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Still looking...

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Fine. But make sure you find it before the ducks get back!

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: The pigeons? They're not here yet. Don't you worry about them, they'll be here.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: I'm sure they'll all get on much better after a nice meal.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Next time you're passing by, please try not to scare off the pigeons. It's hard work to get them to come back again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll be more careful in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Alright. I forgive you. Here, have a Mondstadt hash brown — they're my favorite!

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Mommy says you should always be kind to others.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: WHAT HAVE YOU DONE!? I saw that, you... you... Those poor ducks...!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was for the pigeons...

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Go away! I never want to see you again... EVER!

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: *sobbing* I'm telling Mommy...

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Why aren't my pigeons here yet...
